BrochureContent.Content:
A beautifully presented two-bedroom ground floor apartment in a prime setting
Newcombe Estates are delighted to present this superb two-bedroom ground floor apartment, ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Latchford Park development in Clonee. Overlooking attractive playing fields and enjoying a sunny south-facing balcony, this exceptional home combines generous proportions with an enviable location.
Presented in excellent decorative order, No. 17 offers bright, spacious accommodation designed for modern living. The impressive extra-large living and dining room is flooded with natural light and opens directly onto the private south-facing balcony, creating the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining while enjoying the open aspect. The contemporary fitted kitchen is both stylish and practical, offering ample storage and workspace. There are two generously proportioned double bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from a luxurious en-suite bathroom. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the accommodation.
This outstanding apartment has been meticulously maintained and comes to the market with numerous additional features and upgrades, making it an ideal purchase for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors alike.
Latchford Park enjoys a convenient location within walking distance of Clonee Village, where a wide range of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities are close at hand. Excellent transport links, including easy access to the N3, M50 and Dublin city centre, further enhance the appeal of this superb home.
Features
o	Spacious two-bedroom ground floor apartment
o	South-facing private balcony overlooking playing fields
o	Exceptionally large and bright living/dining room
o	Modern fitted kitchen
o	Two generous double bedrooms
o	Main bedroom with en-suite bathroom
o	Excellent decorative condition throughout
o	Numerous quality extras
o	Walking distance to shops, schools and local amenities
o	Excellent transport links to the N3, M50 and Dublin City Centre
A superb opportunity to acquire a stylish, turnkey apartment in one of Clonee's most convenient and desirable residential developments. Early viewing is highly recommended.
